The rep never explicitly names or flips either deferral objection, but the appointment still lands because the customer's organic frustration with her bill does the work the rep didn't.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: Objection inversion miss on opening deferral
primary_coaching_focus.quote: I don't have any money right now, so I'll be back in about six months.
primary_coaching_focus.why: This is the single highest-leverage moment in the call — a textbook flip trigger appears in the first 15 seconds and the rep answers with a feature pitch instead, forcing three extra minutes of confused back-and-forth that a clean flip would have shortcut.
